verdict.rationale: Rive documents an official MCP server (desktop editor, Windows/macOS) letting AI agents create/manage Rive files, shapes, layouts, component instances, state machines, keyframes, and data binding, which supports agent-driven implementation of design work. However, the story specifically asks for pulling design context like frames, variables, and screenshots via API/MCP — Rive's MCP is described as a tool-use interface for building/editing Rive content, not a documented read/export API for extracting existing frames, variables, or screenshots for arbitrary external design context. missing for 10: explicit API/MCP endpoints for reading existing frames/variables/screenshots as context, independent hands-on verification of the MCP server's real-world reliability, and confirmation of cross-platform (Linux) support.
